name: Mishima Kirara
source:
[b]The Ever-Present Party Girl Junior[/b]

[i]"Paisen, quit lookin’ so gloomy! Let’s get lit already!"[/i]

Meet Kirara, your energetic underclassman who's notorious around campus.
She's the definition of a party-loving gyaru, and quite the local celebrity.
With her outgoing and friendly personality, she'll dive right into anyone's personal space without a second thought.
Word is she's working part-time jobs just to fund her entertainment... though that might not be the whole story.

Hobby: Stashing ¥100 a day
Favorite food: Crêpes
Relationship goal: "We’re playin’ till dawn—no cap."

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.web-marmalade.com/products/sts2/index.html#kirara]Official website[/url]]
